regime_context: The China A-shares thematic detector shows AI Compute & Optics as the prevailing narrative, but with thin breadth (0.118) and negative short-term returns (r10 -0.09). Semiconductors is a strong challenger with higher durability (0.7) and broader participation. Only 6 of 22 themes are trend-eligible, signalling a narrowing rotation. The absolute-trend gate did NOT reduce drawdown historically in this market (gate_helps=false), and the detector’s cross-sectional momentum has no predictive edge. Track record is 0/2, reinforcing that any lean must be highly conditional and low conviction. Innovative Pharma & CXO is crowded—a sizing caution, not a fade.
emerging_watch: Semiconductors (cn_semis) challenging for leadership; watch for a confirmed handoff: if Semis’ score exceeds AI Compute’s for 5 consecutive days and its durability_bar stays above 0.6, the allocation focus may shift. Kill criterion: the margin re-widens to >0.20 in favour of AI Compute for 3 days.

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: AI Compute & Optics holds the top momentum rank and remains eligible under the trend gate, making it the dominant narrative for focus (not alpha). It is not crowded. The overweight is a directional tilt toward the theme that currently concentrates leadership flows, with the understanding that the absolute-trend gate provides no validated edge here and rank-IC is ~0. The thin breadth and marginally negative short-term return argue for high vigilance.
evidence: Leader in rotation detector with margin 0.17 over Semiconductors
theses.dissent: China A-shares historically whipsaw trend gates; the tape may mean-revert. Thin breadth (0.118) and negative r10 signal fragility. Macro backdrop is dominated by unscheduled surprises (0.79 share), which could easily disrupt a narrow AI theme.

falsifier.text: Overweight invalidated if AI Compute & Optics loses eligibility (absolute-trend gate flips) OR its score rank drops below Semiconductors for 5 consecutive trading days with durability_bar falling below 0.4.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
